Full summary: Drafted Doc 2 (2026-08-23-wave2-verification-response.md, 355 lines) directly in the controller after four sleep-killed workflow attempts; two read-only reviewer agents running on it. Wrapper now enumerates Doc 2 questions #6–#8; memory files updated.
Decisions: Chose to draft Doc 2 in the controller session (Bash heredoc from the plan's verified §1 findings + fresh HEAD cites) over a fifth workflow resume — machine sleep killed the Doc 2 drafting lane four times (three sleep-mid-response, one 6× stall); controller drafting is retry-safe and the adversarial review still runs as two parallel read-only Agent lanes
Findings: Doc 2 numbers the continuing verification questions #6 (D15 discriminators a–e), #7 (twining_verify re-measure on ≥2.16.0), #8 (superseded_backfill preview/execute + post-commit why lineage row); #3 and #5 restated from F2. The wrapper references these numbers — keep them stable if Doc 2 is edited.; twining_housekeeping promote_provisionals+execute at HEAD stamps promoted_by 'housekeeping-promote_provisionals' and writes NO status post (housekeeping.ts:314-329) — the one fully silent promote lane, cited in Doc 2 §2.5.
